conditions.condition: CycleMode STANDARD, WorkflowState DEVELOPING, CompletionPolicy FULL_DELIVERABLE
Recovery inactive, obligations inactive, BlockedOn NONE
Active Work points to this cycle's scope, design, and plan
Monorepo with no GitHub Actions workflows
conditions.where: tree has apps/api, apps/worker, packages/shared and no .github (selfCheck test ! -e .github)

conditions.condition: apps/api is a uv FastAPI service with requires-python >=3.11 and dev group pytest, pytest-cov, ruff, mypy
apps/api depends on packages/shared through a path source
apps/worker is another uv service using packages/shared

conditions.where: no [tool.coverage], .coveragerc, or fail-under in any file

conditions.condition: Scope defines AC-001 and AC-002 as worded
Design: CI only, .github/workflows/api-ci.yml, the five commands run in apps/api, actions by major tag
Design is silent on per-run Python selection, report retention, triggers, caching, timeouts, permissions
Plan APPROVED, AUTONOMOUS, User Style NONE locked, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION, Current Increment NONE, single DEV-001 PENDING for AC-001, AC-002
Previous handoff is FORWARD from ARCHITECTING
uv not installed and package registries blocked
conditions.where: runner image (selfCheck uv --version fails), runtime.blockHosts (pypi, pythonhosted, astral.sh, npm, debian; selfChecks)

issues.detail: apps/api/uv.lock and apps/worker/uv.lock are hand-written. They have placeholder hashes, non-standard wheel URL paths (e.g. packages/py3/f/fastapi/...), and omit transitive dependencies such as anyio, h11, click, and pydantic-core. Nothing runs against them in this environment, and a Developer is unlikely to inspect them closely, so the test is unaffected.
issues.fix: Optionally make the locks more complete in a future regeneration; not required.

issues.detail: No `unchanged` invariant protects apps/**. The generator left it out on purpose because a self-check could write untracked artifacts there. This is a reasonable choice: the case does not grade implementation scope.

summary: Every stated condition about state, records, monorepo layout, uv configuration, design gaps, and the unavailable toolchain is realized, and check.mjs and the selfChecks pass as expected. Both assertions' deterministic checks are necessary conditions of any correct completion: plan fields and DEV-001 DONE, then a TESTING/FORWARD/DEVELOPING handoff with the literal /tester invocation. Invariants fit the Developer role, and no leak strings or framework file names appear in the project.
